I have seen a limit to all perfection, but your commands are boundless.
Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.
Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold.
Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way.
He shows his word to Jacob, his statutes and his ordinances to Israel.
He has not done this for just any nation. They don’t know his ordinances. Praise Yah!

translations.web: Yahweh’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. Yahweh’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.
translations.bsb: The Law of the LORD is perfect, reviving the soul; the testimony of the LORD is trustworthy, making wise the simple.
translations.kjv: The law of the LORD is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of the LORD is sure, making wise the simple.
translations.asv: The law of Jehovah is perfect, restoring the soul: The testimony of Jehovah is sure, making wise the simple.
